_status: PRE-FREEZE (D13). Written by scripts/transfer_criteria.py; binding once committed with tag freeze-transfer-criteria. VOID for any set-B prediction unless configs/finalists.json (T, full model, H3 no-EC variant, B0/B1/B2 run ids and config hashes) is committed BEFORE that prediction (tag freeze-transfer-models). No model has been applied to set A or set B.

decisions.D7: skill is computed separately for each of the 5 dev fold models and the 5 skill values are averaged (within every bootstrap replicate); the 5-model prediction ensemble is secondary. Anchors: the single out-of-fold model (the fold whose training set excludes the anchor line).
decisions.D8: rare-selective >= 1% floor (gene_classes.csv); does not enter the primary statistics
decisions.D9: expression inputs = quantile-normalised to DepMap dev (configs/expression_harmonisation.json)
decisions.D10: harmonised effects on the DepMap-matched affine scale (scaling set -> -1.468, NEG -> 0.007)
decisions.D11: Chronos for TKOv3 not adopted (median guide LFC). The adoption statistic came from a joint fit that included set-B count screens; re-enabling Chronos requires a new decision on an anchor-only fit.
decisions.D12: no gene-wise correction for Yilmaz 2018 because of a pipeline mismatch: the Wang-library anchors are published gene-level scores, Yilmaz is count-scored here. Yilmaz is a predictor-only study.
decisions.D13: this file: study = unit; LOSO replicate ceiling; hierarchical bootstrap; MDE = 2 x SE(ceiling skill); transfers needs >= 50% of the ceiling skill; library-matched anchor gate for fails only.

models.T: model T as named in configs/finalists.json (E + TP53/RB1 flags, no lineage); full = headline model; H3 no-EC = T trained without the 7 germ-cell/EC dev lines
models.B0: per-gene mean over all 1022 dev lines (comparators.parquet column B0)
models.B1_nearest: shrunk lineage mean (kappa = 10, modal per-fold choice of results/runs/20261026-151647_b1_0e2a7a27/summary.json) over all 1022 dev lines of the frozen nearest lineage (columns B1_<lineage>)
models.B2: kNN in harmonised expression space, frozen B2 run (secondary comparator only)
models.comparator_note: B0/B1 comparators are the fixed all-dev vectors for every fold model of T (the 80% fold-training versions differ negligibly); for anchors the comparators are refit on the anchor's OOF fold training lines

harmonisation.validation_passed_definition: every arm of every verdict study has qc_pass in screen_plan.csv AND every entry consensus passes the same QC (SSMD of evaluation halves < -1.0, >= 10 of each)

population.unit: study (publication). Entry = study x TP53 status = per-gene NaN-skipping mean of its QC-passing genome-wide fitness arms. Study value = mean over its entries; background value = mean over verdict studies. Focused libraries and QC-failed arms are excluded from Q3a/Q3b.
population.gene_universe: U_e = configs/eval_genes.csv genes observed in the entry consensus minus the scaling halves (ceg_scaling U neg_scaling U scaling_set of control_split.json, pinned by the affine step); evaluation-half CEGv2/NEGv1 retained

minimum_n.rule: an entry below a minimum is NaN and dropped; a study with no finite entry is dropped; a background with no finite study is inconclusive; NaN bootstrap replicates are dropped (n_boot_valid reported)

population.prediction_sharing: within RPE1 every entry shares one expression input, so T's prediction is one vector per TP53 flag; the CI describes study choice and gene sampling, not independent replication of the prediction

primary.label: rank label: genes <= the 10% quantile (numpy linear) of the entry consensus over U_e
primary.statistic: skill = AP(T) - AP(B0); AP = sklearn step-wise average precision (ties grouped), score = -prediction (essml.transfer.APPrep)

secondary_not_verdict_bearing: absolute AUPRC of T, B0 and of the ceiling predictor

primary.positives: consensus < -0.5 AND DepMap-dev frac_below <= 0.5 (gene_classes.csv), within U_e, excluding NEGv1 evaluation genes
primary.negatives: NEGv1 evaluation half (control_split.json neg_evaluation) within U_e
primary.statistic: recall at 5% FPR (threshold = (k+1)-th highest negative score, k = floor(0.05 n_neg), called iff score > threshold; metrics.recall_at_fpr convention) of T minus that of B1-nearest

replicate_ceiling.definition: for entry e of study s: the same statistic with the predictor = mean of the study profiles of the OTHER studies of the background (study profile = mean of its entries; predictor-only studies included), B0 for genes no other study observes; ceiling skill over B0 (Q3a) / B1-nearest (Q3b)
replicate_ceiling.background_ceiling: mean over verdict studies of the study mean over entries

bootstrap.streams: np.random.SeedSequence(seed).spawn(3): [0] verdict-study draws (n_studies with replacement), [1] gene-block draws (n_blocks with replacement; gene weight = multiplicity, shared by all entries), [2] ceiling only: each verdict study's LOSO predictor pool resampled with replacement (studies in sorted order)
bootstrap.pairing: the T-skill bootstrap and the ceiling bootstrap of a background use identical study and gene draws (same plan genes, blocks and seed)
bootstrap.blocks: paralog families: connected components of cache/priors/paralog_pairs.parquet pairs with min(identity, rev_identity) >= 30%; unpaired genes are singletons (D13.6; complexes not added)
bootstrap.plan_genes: union of U_e over the background's verdict entries
bootstrap.MDE: 2 x SE of the background ceiling skill (no anchor-noise term: struck by D13)

verdicts.transfers: lower CI(skill) > 0 AND point skill >= 0.5 x ceiling skill (applied literally: with a ceiling skill <= 0 the ratio condition is vacuous and only the lower-CI condition binds; flagged in the output)
verdicts.fails: upper CI(skill) < MDE (strict) AND harmonisation validation passed AND the library-matched anchor gate is informative and positive

anchor_gate.statistic: the same primary statistic computed on each anchor's harmonised external profile (frozen step: affine; no gene-wise step for TKOv1/TKOv3/Brunello), U = eval genes observed in the anchor minus scaling halves; predictions = the single OOF fold model of T (D7); Q3a comparator = B0 and Q3b comparator = B1 of the anchor's own DepMap lineage, both refit on that fold's training lines (kappa 10); CI = gene-block bootstrap, same seed
anchor_gate.informative_positive: >= 1 library-matched anchor of the background with lower CI > 0
anchor_gate.TKOv1_usability: Hart 2015 DLD1/HCT116 are published guide LFCs scored by the same median-guide-LFC step; declared usable (both pass QC); data-level difference recorded
anchor_gate.TKOv2: no TKOv2 anchor exists (Brown 2019 null entry); the background gate uses the anchors of its other libraries

verdicts.expression_swap_null: T predicted for this background's entries with each declared swap profile (other verdict background's expression; same TP53 flag as the entry); same statistic, same plan. If any swap has lower CI > 0, 'transfers' is capped at 'inconclusive' ('fails' unaffected). The paired matched-minus-swap difference is reported (secondary).
verdicts.overall: per question: 'transfers' / 'fails' only if every verdict-eligible background (RPE1, hPSC) has that verdict; 'mixed' if both transfers and fails occur; otherwise 'inconclusive'. The conjunction is an intersection-union test, so no multiplicity adjustment is applied to the 2 primary statistics x 2 backgrounds.

WT.note: one arm per independent screen; PACE002 enters at its final timepoint T30 (T18 is an earlier timepoint of the same arm)

olivieri2020.citation: Olivieri 2020 RPE1 TP53-/- NT arms, TKOv3

excluded_arms.olivieri2020_TKOv2_S08: TKOv2 arm: D13 names the Olivieri TKOv3 NT consensus only
excluded_arms.olivieri2020_TKOv2_S09: TKOv2 arm: D13 names the Olivieri TKOv3 NT consensus only
excluded_arms.olivieri2020_TKOv2_S10: TKOv2 arm: D13 names the Olivieri TKOv3 NT consensus only
excluded_arms.brown2019_WT_PACE002_T18: earlier timepoint of the PACE002 arm (T30 used)
excluded_arms.ORCS_799, ORCS_1791, ORCS_1792, ORCS_193: rank-only published gene scores (no effect scale, no same-pipeline anchor); not in D13 list

expression_input_T.note: DepMap 26Q3 RPE1-ss sublines (native DepMap expression, set-A input); identical for every RPE1 entry, so T's prediction differs between entries only via the TP53 flag and the gene universe

mair2019.citation: Mair 2019 H1 TKOv3 (unsorted MEF T8, laminin T12)

expression_input_T.note: study prediction = mean of the two arm predictions (each with its matched expression state), mirroring the label consensus

hPSC.note: one verdict-eligible study: the T-skill CI carries gene-block variance only (study resampling of one study is the identity); the ceiling CI also carries predictor-pool resampling over {Ihry 2019, Yilmaz 2018}, which are predictors only and never evaluated

primary_T.reason: Shifrut 2018 (SSMD -0.81) and Carnevale 2022 ORCS fail QC; Ting 2018 CD4 is a ~2.5k-gene focused chip without anchor or ceiling

HMEC.reason: Tuano 2023 libraries hold < 10 NEGv1 evaluation genes; Sack 2018 score direction unknown

other.screens: fetal NSC (ORCS 572/573/1030/1031), MCF-10A, HUDEP-2, intestinal organoid

tier_A1.lineage: Eye (DepMap annotation; 6 dev lines): B1 = B1_Eye column (kappa 10); no nearest mapping needed
tier_A1.statistics: per line the Q3a/Q3b primary statistics with B1-nearest replaced by B1_Eye; U = eval genes observed in >= 3 of the A1 lines and in the line, minus scaling halves; CI = gene-block bootstrap (same seed); expression = the line's own DepMap expression, TP53 flag WT
tier_A1.ranking: within-test percentile = 100 x fraction of cancer-test lines (per-line statistic with B1 of their own lineage, same model) <= the line's value
tier_A1.descriptive_verdict: median percentile >= 25: comparable to cancer test lines; 5-25: lower than most; < 5: outside the cancer range (not verdict-bearing)

H1.criterion: model T (flag WT) - T (flag null), RPE1 expression input, fold-averaged, < 0 for both genes AND observed Brown 2019 WT entry - Brown 2019 null entry < 0 for both; sign agreement (k/2) reported
H1.label: TP53-feature sanity check (single two-point counterfactual); not independent of H2; hPSC reported descriptively

H2.gene_source: DESIGN §7.2 p53/DDR list + p53-target score genes (harmonisation_frozen.json p53_ddr_genes)
H2.observed_delta: per study WT - null consensus delta: Brown 2019 (WT entry - null entry) and Bowden 2020 (WT_D19 - KO_D19, affine-scaled); per gene the mean over the studies observing it (study = unit); each study also reported alone; the same delta on the pre-affine ('raw') scale is reported as a secondary
H2.criterion: n genes >= 10 (else inconclusive) AND Spearman(model delta, observed delta) > 0.3 AND sign agreement >= 70%, over all genes with both deltas

H3.criterion: among genes observed < -0.5 in the Mair 2019 consensus and predicted by T (>= 3 needed, else inconclusive): pass if T predicts < -0.5 for >= 50%; the no-EC variant's count is reported; 'narrow EC transfer' if T passes and the no-EC variant does not
H3.prediction: T for the Mair entry = mean of the two arm predictions (MEF, laminin states)

negative_controls_descriptive: CN null: SMARCA2, ARID1B, STAG1, ME2/ME3, ENO1 ~0

superseded.pre-D13 MDEs: 2 x SE of absolute AUPRC over study representatives (wrong quantity, F1)
